_about: Public-domain Gustav Friedrich Oehler (1812-1872, Tübingen) in English for the Word Hoard: the Theology of the Old Testament in Clark's two volumes, tr. Ellen D. Smith and Sophia Taylor (1874-1875), and George E. Day's revised American edition (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1883), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

oehler-theology-ot-1: Theology of the Old Testament, vol. I, tr. Ellen D. Smith (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1874)
oehler-theology-ot-2: Theology of the Old Testament, vol. II, tr. Sophia Taylor (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1875)
oehler-theology-ot-day: Theology of the Old Testament, a revision of the Clark translation by George E. Day (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1883)

_alternates.oehler-copies: The 1880 Clark reissue; Day's 1884-1888 editions; CCEL's ot_theol is page images only
